column1: # 2-field allele catalog for handoff to Claude Code. EXPORTED from the saved engageability/HED tables,
# NOT re-derived from IMGT. Columns: catalog_allele (e.g. A*02:01), locus (A/B/C). Nothing else by design:
# no engageability, no HED, no frequency, no supertype. Downstream code is pre-registered not to inspect any
# capacity-vs-engageability relationship before its gate; that constraint must not depend on an agent
# declining to read a column it was handed.
# Engageability and HED tables have IDENTICAL membership (676==676, symmetric difference empty).
# IMGT/HLA release the saved tables were built from: IPD-IMGT/HLA 3.64.0 (alignments fetched 2026-04-16).
